summary: The core Elixir business-logic layer of the Barkpark CMS: document/schema CRUD with draft-publish lifecycle, multi-tenant isolation, plugin extensibility, webhooks, tasks, sheets, auth, and sharing. It is the single source of truth all other surfaces (Studio, API controllers, CLI, plugins) delegate to.

intentions.title: Provide a clean, extensible plugin highway that keeps the core always bootable
intentions.evidence: plugin.ex defines a strict behaviour contract (schemas+logic only, never UI) with compile-time-only discovery and a fresh-install invariant enforced by a boot test. schema_bootstrap.ex auto-registers plugin schemas on every boot. The forbidden-surfaces list in plugin.ex and tenancy scoping in content.ex prevent plugins from bypassing the host lifecycle.

intentions.title: Enforce hard multi-tenant isolation at the data layer
intentions.evidence: tenancy.ex, webhooks.ex, sharing.ex, and content.ex all scope every query to (workspace_id, project_id, dataset_id). Webhooks scope is enforced in WHERE clauses so cross-tenant id-guessing returns :not_found. sharing.ex is default-OFF and default-DENY — active only when an exact (ws/project/dataset) triple is configured.

intentions.title: Implement a Sanity-compatible draft/publish document lifecycle
intentions.evidence: content.ex leads with a detailed @moduledoc on the drafts. prefix convention, three perspectives (:published, :drafts, :raw), and the publish/unpublish/discard_draft operations. tasks.ex adds a separate lifecycle_status axis on task documents to avoid polluting the Sanity status axis.

intentions.title: Ship a task substrate that lets agent orchestrators claim and close work atomically
intentions.evidence: tasks.ex stores tasks as documents with a content.lifecycle_status field and CAS claim epochs; tasks/ttl_sweeper.ex reaps stale agent claims; tasks/compactor.ex compacts the storage; tasks/edge.ex tracks dependency DAG edges. The whole system is what bp task claim/close/ready/next rides on.

intentions.title: Deliver reliable webhook fan-out with HMAC signing, retry, and idempotency
intentions.evidence: webhooks/dispatcher.ex signs payloads and retries delivery; webhooks/webhook.ex rotates secrets; webhooks/delivery.ex records each attempt. idempotency.ex deduplicates mutation writes by key so retried clients don't double-apply.

intentions.title: Expose fine-grained, revocable API token auth with time-bounded sharing grants
intentions.evidence: auth.ex verifies tokens with revocation + expiry enforced in SQL (never post-filter, to prevent existence leaks). preview_token.ex issues short-lived HS256 JWTs for preview routes. auth.ex models share-edit tokens with a 7-day default TTL and hard 1-year cap, restricted to (docs, media) surfaces only.

intentions.title: Embed a collaborative spreadsheet engine inside the CMS document model
intentions.evidence: sheets.ex, sheets/engine.ex (formula subset with cycle detection), sheets/session.ex (per-sheet GenServer with debounced persist and op batching up to 1000/call), sheets/structure.ex (ref-shift on row/col inserts). Sheets live as type:sheet documents, plugged into the same draft-publish and PubSub pipeline.

intentions.title: Support content-graph edges between documents as a first-class primitive
intentions.evidence: content.ex imports Content.Edge; tasks/edge.ex is the Ecto schema for task dependency edges. The graph-edge goal dogfoods Barkpark's own content graph, treating edges as the dual of the Indx retriever seam.

intentions.title: Keep the system observable and operationally safe in production
intentions.evidence: application.ex wires the OTP supervision tree; telemetry/handlers.ex attaches Oban and plugin telemetry; rate_limiter.ex provides ETS token-bucket rate limiting; vault.ex + encrypted_map.ex encrypt sensitive fields at rest; release.ex runs migrations without the app running; workers/smoke.ex provides an Oban smoke-test worker.
